meaning:
δι-απορέω, -ῶ
[in Sm.: Psa.77:5, Dan.2:1 * ;]
to be quite at a loss, be in great perplexity: absol., Act.2:12; before διὰ τό, with inf., Luk.9:7; περί, Act.5:24; ἐν ἑαυτῷ, Act.10:17.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,
They were all amazed, and were perplexed, saying to one another, “What does this mean?”
